track.title: Consternation At The Disco
track.credit: 配乐：Wax Lyricist《Consternation At The Disco》（CC0 1.0 公共领域）

plan.why: cold open on groove B (full kit + bass)
title on the breakdown (-29.5 dB, keys only): the band stops on 5:1
pain: the long drumless breakdown, ending in a gap (end of CD 66 = 20:4)
DROP on 21:1 = drums back after the gap (+12.7 dB step)
ADD-2 (inserted bar after 28): full groove arrives
AI section on the steady groove (the song has no thinner groove here)
the wait: back into the breakdown (-29.5 dB)
PAYOFF on the song's drop (breakdown -> full band, +12 dB)
end card on the last full section
ADD-1 (end card +1 bar): the song's final hit, rings into the tail

title_stop.note: the band drops to the -29.5 dB breakdown exactly on 5:1 (SFX impact carries the hit)

drop.note: gap on 20:4, drums back +12.7 dB on 21:1

payoff.note: breakdown on 49-50 -> the song's own drop on 51:1 (+12 dB, louder than 21:1)

break.note: drumless bars instead of stop-time hits
